plugins.name: WP Accessibility Helper (WAH)
plugins.author: Alex Volkov
plugins.short_description: Short Description WP Accessibility Helper helps solve accessibility problems
plugins.description:
WordPress Accessibility made easy!

Web accessibility refers to the inclusive practice of removing barriers that prevent interaction with, or access to websites, by people with disabilities. When sites are correctly designed, developed and edited, all users have equal access to information and functionality.

WP Accessibility Helper helps solve accessibility problems like font size, contrast, titles and aria-label tags, images alt and more.

Official website

English version:

https://accessibility-helper.co.il/

Hebrew version:

https://accessibility-helper.co.il/il/

Privacy terms

  • WAH free uses cookies to save contrast variation colors selected by user
  • We are using cookies for internal usage only and never provide this data to the third party organizations/companies

plugins.name: WP Nice Loader
plugins.author: Alex Volkov
plugins.short_description: WP Nice Loader allows you control over page preloader, font size, themes and more.
plugins.description:
WP Nice Loader allows you control over page preloader, font size, themes and much more.

A few notes about the plugin:

  • You can easily create nice page loaders with one click
  • Control over the title, subtitle and loader logo
  • Change text colors
  • 13 loaders themes (9 of them based on spinkit by @tobiasahlin – DEMO )
